TechMagic and CSS launch managed food operations with cooking robots

The service combines kitchen design, robotics and operations, building on the previously opened MAGIC CHEF cafeteria.

TechMagic / PR Times ↗20 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 6

The new development

TechMagic and CSS Holdings announced the full launch of a managed food-operations service on November 20, combining robotics with on-site operating expertise. This is a service-launch milestone, not a new opening of MAGIC CHEF: the demonstration cafeteria at Telecom Center opened in May 2026.

Technology and applications

The offering spans kitchen design, equipment installation and day-to-day operation. I-Robo 2 supports stir-frying and washing, while M-Robo assists with weighing and plating. Combining equipment with an operating team aims to reduce customers’ need to coordinate multiple suppliers and align the kitchen’s working procedures.

Scope and next steps

The companies report about 20% higher sales at the example location versus the previous year before renovation. That comparison does not isolate robotics from menu or management changes. Target settings include cafeterias, hotels, leisure facilities and elderly care, with suitability and economics still requiring site-specific assessment.
